FROM channel WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY id

aggregated.hour_06, aggregated.hour_07, aggregated.hour_08, aggregated.hour_09, aggregated.hour_10, aggregated.hour_11, aggregated.hour_12, aggregated.hour_13, aggregated.hour_14, aggregated.hour_15, stat_date, st.final_channel_id AS channel_id, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_00, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_01, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_02, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_03, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_04, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_05, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_06, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_07, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_08, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_09, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_10, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_11, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_12, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_13, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_14, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_15, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_16, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_17, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_18, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_19, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_20, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_21, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_22, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.updated_at) = 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_23 FROM short_url su INNER JOIN send_target st ON st.id = su.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 INNER JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 INNER JOIN channel c ON c.id = st.final_channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(su.is_converted, 0) = 1 AND su.updated_at IS NOT NULL AND sh.status = 'SENT' AND st.final_channel_id IS NOT NULL
AND su.updated_at >= CAST(#{from} AS TIMESTAMP)
AND su.updated_at < CAST(#{to} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY
AND c.channel_type = #{channel}
GROUP BY TRUNC(su.updated_at), st.final_channel_id ) aggregated ORDER BY aggregated.stat_date, aggregated.channel_id
